hochschule-fur-bildende-kunste-hamburg.name: Hochschule für bildende Künste Hamburg
hochschule-fur-bildende-kunste-hamburg.description: HFBK Hamburg offers interdisciplinary Fine Arts degrees, with Film as a study focus at BFA and MFA level. Its Film teaching centres on artistic authorship, experimental independent and collective projects, fiction and non-fiction, and analogue and digital practice. The Film page separately describes an HMS cooperative master: Hamburg Media School runs that programme while HFBK awards its degree and holds academic responsibility. Do not confuse it with the on-campus Fine Arts Film focus.

fees.appliesTo: HFBK-run programmes; HMS cooperative master not covered by this fee statement
fees.notes: No tuition at HFBK, but mandatory semester contributions remain. Do not transfer this tuition statement to the separately administered HMS programme.
Administrative, AStA and Studierendenwerk contributions plus the semester transport ticket remain mandatory. The FAQ says amounts vary; confirm the fee for your enrolment semester.

hochschule-der-bildenden-kunste-saar.name: Hochschule der Bildenden Künste Saar
hochschule-der-bildenden-kunste-saar.description: The Saar College of Fine Arts (HBK Saar) is a public art school in Saarbrücken, Saarland. It offers programs in fine arts, design, and art education, with a focus on practical, conceptual, and theoretical aspects of contemporary art and design practices.

fees.notes: Tuition only; separate semester contribution.

hochschule-fur-bildende-kunste-braunschw.name: Hochschule für Bildende Künste Braunschweig
hochschule-fur-bildende-kunste-braunschw.description: The Braunschweig University of Art (HBK Braunschweig) is a public art school in Lower Saxony with a strong focus on interdisciplinary art education. It offers programs in fine arts, design, and art education, emphasizing both practical skills and theoretical knowledge in contemporary art and design practices.

hochschule-fur-musik-und-theater-rostock.name: Hochschule für Musik und Theater Rostock
hochschule-fur-musik-und-theater-rostock.description: The Rostock University of Music and Theatre (HMT Rostock) is a public university for music and performing arts in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Germany. It offers a wide range of programs in music performance, education, and theater.

fees.notes: Processing fee for application/admission.

kunstakademie-dusseldorf.name: Kunstakademie Düsseldorf
kunstakademie-dusseldorf.description: Founded in 1773, the Kunstakademie Düsseldorf is one of Germany's most prestigious art schools. It has produced numerous influential artists including Joseph Beuys, Gerhard Richter, and Anselm Kiefer. The academy emphasizes independent artistic development within a class-based system led by internationally renowned professors.

fees.notes: Bewerbungsgebühr in Höhe von 30 €.

universitat-der-kunste-berlin.name: Universität der Künste Berlin
universitat-der-kunste-berlin.description: The Berlin University of the Arts (UdK Berlin) is one of the largest, most diverse and renowned art colleges in the world. The teaching offered at the four colleges of Fine Art, Design, Music and Performing Arts, as well as at the Central Institute of Further Education, encompasses the full spectrum of the arts and related academic studies in more than 70 courses.

staatliche-hochschule-fur-gestaltung-kar.name: Staatliche Hochschule für Gestaltung Karlsruhe
staatliche-hochschule-fur-gestaltung-kar.description: Karlsruhe University of Arts and Design was first established as a progressive school on April 15, 1992. It was founded by Heinrich Klotz between the years 1989 and 1992, together with the ZKM | Center for Art and Media Karlsruhe. The combination of teaching, research, and exhibition institutions addresses the given artistic and pedagogic task of relating traditional arts to media technology and electronic production processes.

application_route.notes: Online application only through the university portal.
application_route.scope: Regular degree applicants, not exchange students

hochschule-fur-kunste-bremen.name: Hochschule für Künste Bremen
hochschule-fur-kunste-bremen.description: The University of the Arts Bremen (HfK) is a public art college in Bremen, Germany. It was founded in 1873 and offers programs in fine arts, design, digital media, and music. The university is known for its interdisciplinary approach and international orientation.

staatliche-akademie-der-bildenden-kunste.name: Staatliche Akademie der Bildenden Künste Stuttgart
staatliche-akademie-der-bildenden-kunste.description: The State Academy of Fine Arts Stuttgart (ABK Stuttgart) is one of the oldest and largest art schools in Germany. Founded in 1761, it offers a wide range of programs in fine arts, architecture, design, art education, and conservation.

application_route.notes: Online-Antrag in HISinOne, Bewerbungsunterlagen per Post, digitale Arbeitsprobe hochladen

kunsthochschule-fur-medien-koln.name: Kunsthochschule für Medien Köln
kunsthochschule-fur-medien-koln.description: The Academy of Media Arts Cologne (KHM) is unique in Germany, offering a project-based 'Media Arts' diploma program that brings together practices from art, film, and theory. It provides resources for independent artistic work across various media forms.

hochschule-fur-gestaltung-offenbach.name: Hochschule für Gestaltung Offenbach
hochschule-fur-gestaltung-offenbach.description: HfG Offenbach offers bachelor’s and master’s programmes in Art (Kunst) and Design. New entrants moved to these programmes in winter 2022/23; existing diploma students can continue in the phased-out diploma programmes.

hochschule-fur-grafik-und-buchkunst-leip.name: Hochschule für Grafik und Buchkunst Leipzig
hochschule-fur-grafik-und-buchkunst-leip.description: The Academy of Fine Arts Leipzig (HGB) is one of the oldest art schools in Germany. It offers diploma programs in Painting/Graphics, Book Design/Graphic Design, Photography, and Media Art, as well as a Master's program in Cultures of the Curatorial.

fees.appliesTo: students already holding a degree, if study exceeds prior Regelstudienzeit by six semesters

muthesius-kunsthochschule-kiel.name: Muthesius Kunsthochschule Kiel
muthesius-kunsthochschule-kiel.description: The Muthesius University of Fine Arts and Design in Kiel is the only art university in Schleswig-Holstein. It offers Bachelor's and Master's programs in Fine Arts, Communication Design, Industrial Design, and Spatial Strategies.

fees.notes: No tuition fees in Schleswig-Holstein.

bauhaus-universitat-weimar.name: Bauhaus-Universität Weimar
bauhaus-universitat-weimar.description: The Bauhaus-Universität Weimar is a university located in Weimar, Germany, specializing in the artistic and technical fields. Established in 1860 as the Great Ducal Saxon Art School, it gained collegiate status on 3 June 1910. In 1919 the school was renamed Bauhaus by its new director Walter Gropius and it received its present name in 1996.

alanus-hochschule-fur-kunst-und-gesellsc.name: Alanus Hochschule für Kunst und Gesellschaft
alanus-hochschule-fur-kunst-und-gesellsc.description: Alanus University of Arts and Social Sciences is a private university in Alfter, near Bonn. It offers programs in fine arts, art education, and social sciences, with a focus on interdisciplinary and practice-oriented learning.

hochschule-der-bildenden-kunste-essen.name: Hochschule der bildenden Künste Essen
hochschule-der-bildenden-kunste-essen.description: The Hochschule der bildenden Künste Essen is a young art academy in the Ruhr area, offering programs in fine arts with a focus on contemporary artistic practice.

application_route.notes: Mit der Einreichung deiner formalen Bewerbungsunterlagen über unser Onlineformular erledigst Du den ersten Schritt des Bewerbungsverfahrens.

hochschule-macromedia.name: Hochschule Macromedia
hochschule-macromedia.description: Hochschule Macromedia is a private university of applied sciences with campuses in several German cities, offering programs in media, design, and communication.

merz-akademie.name: Merz Akademie
merz-akademie.description: Merz Akademie is a university of applied sciences for design, art, and media in Stuttgart, offering interdisciplinary programs with a focus on creative and critical thinking.

hochschule-fur-fernsehen-und-film-munche.name: Hochschule für Fernsehen und Film München
hochschule-fur-fernsehen-und-film-munche.description: The University of Television and Film Munich (HFF München) is one of the most renowned film schools in Germany, offering programs in film and television production, directing, and screenwriting.

filmuniversitat-babelsberg-konrad-wolf.name: Filmuniversität Babelsberg KONRAD WOLF
filmuniversitat-babelsberg-konrad-wolf.description: Filmuniversität Babelsberg KONRAD WOLF is Germany's oldest and largest film university, located in Potsdam-Babelsberg. It offers a wide range of programs in film, television, animation, production, and media studies, combining artistic practice with academic research. The university is renowned for its close ties to the film industry and its international collaborations.

hochschule-fur-gestaltung-schwabisch-gmu.name: Hochschule für Gestaltung Schwäbisch Gmünd
hochschule-fur-gestaltung-schwabisch-gmu.description: The Hochschule für Gestaltung Schwäbisch Gmünd (HfG Schwäbisch Gmünd) is a renowned university of design in Baden-Württemberg, Germany. It offers bachelor's and master's programs in interaction design, communication design, product design, and strategic design, with a strong focus on practical, interdisciplinary, and innovative approaches to design education. The university is known for its close ties to industry and its international orientation.

bard-college-berlin.name: Bard College Berlin
bard-college-berlin.description: Bard College Berlin is a private, non-profit liberal arts college in Berlin, Germany, offering intensive, English-taught Bachelor of Arts degrees in Humanities, the Arts, and Social Thought, and in Economics, Politics, and Social Thought. It emphasizes small seminar-style classes, critical thinking, and close engagement with core texts and ideas. It is part of the Bard College network.

fees.notes: Off-campus comprehensive fee of €27,500 per year for the 2026–27 academic year, covering tuition, mental health service, and sport/fitness facility access.
On-campus comprehensive fee of €38,250 per year for the 2026–27 academic year, covering tuition, housing, meal plan, mental health service, and sport/fitness facility access.

academy-of-visual-arts-frankfurt.name: Academy of Visual Arts Frankfurt
academy-of-visual-arts-frankfurt.description: The Academy of Visual Arts Frankfurt is a private, state-recognized academy in Hesse, Germany. It offers Bachelor of Arts programs in Visual Arts and Communication Design, emphasizing both classical techniques and contemporary practices. The academy provides a practice-oriented education with individual support in small classes.

application_route.notes: Direct online application via school website

fachhochschule-potsdam.name: Fachhochschule Potsdam
fachhochschule-potsdam.description: Fachhochschule Potsdam (FHP) is a university of applied sciences in Brandenburg, known for its strong design department and practice-oriented education. It offers a variety of programs in interface design, communication design, product design, and European media studies, emphasizing interdisciplinary projects, innovation, and social responsibility. The university has close ties to cultural institutions and the media industry in the Berlin-Brandenburg metropolitan region.

hochschule-darmstadt.name: Hochschule Darmstadt
hochschule-darmstadt.description: Hochschule Darmstadt offers programmes in architecture, media and design. Its current catalogue includes Animation and Game, Expanded Media, Motion Pictures, User Experience Design, Sound, Music and Production, Communication Design and Industrial Design, alongside architecture and interior architecture programmes.

hochschule-rhein-waal.name: Hochschule Rhein-Waal
hochschule-rhein-waal.description: Hochschule Rhein-Waal is a young, innovative university of applied sciences with a strong international orientation. It offers a wide range of English-taught programs in design, communication, media, computer science, and environmental sciences. The university is known for its interdisciplinary approach, modern campus, and focus on sustainability and global collaboration.

fees.notes: Semesterbeitrag für das Wintersemester 2026/27 (enthält Deutschlandticket 226,80 €).

technische-universitat-berlin.name: Technische Universität Berlin
technische-universitat-berlin.description: Technische Universität Berlin (TU Berlin) is one of Germany's largest and most internationally renowned technical universities. It offers a wide range of programs with a strong emphasis on research and innovation, particularly in engineering, computer science, and technology-driven arts and media. Its media-related programs are known for their interdisciplinary approach and focus on cutting-edge research in areas like human-computer interaction and design computation.

hochschule-anhalt.name: Hochschule Anhalt
hochschule-anhalt.description: Hochschule Anhalt is a university of applied sciences located in Saxony-Anhalt, with a significant design department in Dessau, the heart of the Bauhaus movement. It offers a range of programs in design, visual communication, and architecture, emphasizing practical education, interdisciplinary projects, and the rich heritage of Bauhaus design principles. The Dessau International Architecture Graduate School (DIA) is a notable part of its offerings.

universitat-trier.name: Universität Trier
universitat-trier.description: The University of Trier, one of Germany's oldest universities, re-established in 1970, is a public research university in Rhineland-Palatinate. It offers a strong profile in humanities, social sciences, and law, with notable programs in media studies, communication, and digital humanities. The university is situated in a city with a rich Roman history, influencing its cultural and historical research focus.

fees.notes: Semester contribution for new enrollees in Winter Semester 2026/27.

universitat-siegen.name: Universität Siegen
universitat-siegen.description: The University of Siegen is a public research university in North Rhine-Westphalia, known for its interdisciplinary approach and strong focus on media studies, human-computer interaction, and social sciences. It offers a range of programs in these fields, often combining theoretical knowledge with practical application and research.

technische-hochschule-ingolstadt.name: Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt
technische-hochschule-ingolstadt.description: Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt (THI) is a leading university of applied sciences in Bavaria, known for its innovative programs in design, user experience, mobility, and engineering. The university emphasizes practical training, research, and strong industry partnerships, preparing students for careers in digital product design, mobility, and user experience.

fees.appliesTo: Bachelor students from third countries (non-EU, non-EEA)

technische-hochschule-augsburg.name: Technische Hochschule Augsburg
technische-hochschule-augsburg.description: Technische Hochschule Augsburg (THA) is a dynamic university of applied sciences in Bavaria, offering innovative programs in interactive media, communication design, and digital systems. The university is known for its interdisciplinary approach, strong industry links, and focus on digital transformation and creative industries.

universitat-passau.name: Universität Passau
universitat-passau.description: The University of Passau is a public research university in Bavaria, known for its strong international focus and interdisciplinary programs in law, business, humanities, and computer science. Its media and communication programs integrate theoretical knowledge with practical skills, often exploring the impact of digitalization on society and culture.

universitat-wurzburg.name: Universität Würzburg
universitat-wurzburg.description: The Julius-Maximilians-Universität Würzburg, founded in 1402, is one of Germany's oldest and most traditional universities. It offers a broad range of disciplines, including humanities, medicine, natural sciences, and technology. Its programs in media communication and human-computer systems combine strong theoretical foundations with research-oriented and applied projects.

rwth-aachen-university.name: RWTH Aachen University
rwth-aachen-university.description: RWTH Aachen University is one of Europe's leading technical universities, renowned for its research and teaching in engineering, media informatics, and digital media. The university offers a wide range of bachelor's and master's programs, with a strong focus on innovation, internationalization, and industry collaboration.

technische-universitat-munchen.name: Technische Universität München
technische-universitat-munchen.description: The Technical University of Munich (TUM) is one of Europe's leading research universities, consistently ranked among the top universities globally. It excels in engineering, natural sciences, life sciences, medicine, and management. TUM offers innovative programs at the intersection of technology and creative fields, such as Games Engineering and Computational Science, fostering a strong entrepreneurial spirit and close ties with industry.

koln-international-school-of-design.name: Köln International School of Design
koln-international-school-of-design.description: The Köln International School of Design (KISD) is a public design university founded in 1991 in Cologne, Germany. It offers interdisciplinary programs in integrated design, communication design, and product design. KISD is known for its international orientation and focus on sustainable and social design practices.

hochschule-reutlingen.name: Hochschule Reutlingen
hochschule-reutlingen.description: Hochschule Reutlingen (Reutlingen University) is a public university of applied sciences founded in 1855. It offers programs in design, engineering, and business. The Faculty of Design is known for its focus on textile design, product design, and communication design.

fees.appliesTo: students in a second degree (Zweitstudium) in Baden-Württemberg

kunsthochschule-mainz.name: Kunsthochschule Mainz
kunsthochschule-mainz.description: Kunsthochschule Mainz (Mainz University of Fine Arts) is a public art school founded in 1975. It offers programs in fine arts and visual communication, with a focus on interdisciplinary art practice and experimental approaches.

kunsthochschule-kassel.name: Kunsthochschule Kassel
kunsthochschule-kassel.description: Kunsthochschule Kassel (Kassel University of Fine Arts) is one of Germany's oldest art schools, founded in 1777. It offers programs in fine arts and visual communication, and is known for its experimental approach and strong focus on contemporary art practices.

hochschule-pforzheim.name: Hochschule Pforzheim
hochschule-pforzheim.description: Hochschule Pforzheim (Pforzheim University) is a public university of applied sciences founded in 1877. It is one of Germany's leading design schools, known for its programs in industrial design, transportation design, jewelry design, fashion, and visual communication.

hdm-stuttgart.name: Hochschule für Medien Stuttgart
hdm-stuttgart.description: The Stuttgart Media University (Hochschule für Medien Stuttgart, HdM) is a state university of media studies in Stuttgart, Germany, offering nearly 30 accredited bachelor's and master's degree programs within three faculties. Founded in 2001, it is located at Nobelstraße 10 in the University of Stuttgart Campus Vaihingen.

fees.notes: Valid from WS 2024/25, composed of €80 administration fee (from 01.01.2025), €15 student body fee, and €96.50 student services fee.

kunstakademie-munster.name: Kunstakademie Münster
kunstakademie-munster.description: Kunstakademie Münster (Academy of Fine Arts Münster) is a public art school founded in 1971 and located at Leonardo-Campus 2 in Münster. It offers programs in Fine Arts with an emphasis on artistic freedom and self-determination. The academy provides studio-based learning in artistic classes complemented by technical workshops and art-related sciences.

fees.notes: Die Kunstakademie Münster erhebt keine Studiengebühren.

akademie-munchen.name: Akademie der Bildenden Künste München
akademie-munchen.description: The Academy of Fine Arts Munich is one of Germany's oldest and most prestigious art academies, founded in 1808. It offers programs in fine arts, design, and media art.

fees.notes: Semesterbeitrag Grundbeitrag Studentenwerk 97 Euro for WS 2026/27

akademie-nurnberg.name: Akademie der Bildenden Künste Nürnberg
akademie-nurnberg.description: The Academy of Fine Arts Nuremberg is one of Germany's oldest art schools, founded in 1662. It offers programs in fine arts with a focus on classical and contemporary art practices.

burg-giebichenstein.name: Burg Giebichenstein Kunsthochschule Halle
burg-giebichenstein.description: Burg Giebichenstein Kunsthochschule Halle is one of Germany's oldest art schools, founded in 1879. It offers programs in fine arts and design with a strong emphasis on craft traditions and contemporary practices.

application_route.notes: International undergraduate applicants without a German higher education entrance qualification must obtain a VPD from uni-assist before submitting through the Burg portal.

fees.notes: No tuition fees are charged for primary Bachelor, consecutive Master, or Diplom programs.

folkwang-essen.name: Folkwang Universität der Künste
folkwang-essen.description: Folkwang Universität der Künste is one of Germany's leading arts universities, founded in 1927. It offers programs in music, theater, dance, and design with a holistic approach to arts education.

haw-hamburg.name: Hochschule für Angewandte Wissenschaften Hamburg
haw-hamburg.description: Hochschule für Angewandte Wissenschaften Hamburg (HAW Hamburg) is one of Germany's largest universities of applied sciences, offering design programs with a practical focus.

fees.notes: For Wintersemester 2026/27, includes Studierendenwerk (€101), Studierendenschaft (€19.10), Semesterticket (€226.80), Härtefonds (€0.10), and Verwaltungskostenbeitrag (€50).
No tuition fees are charged for most degree programs at HAW Hamburg, only the semester contribution.

hfbk-dresden.name: Hochschule für Bildende Künste Dresden
hfbk-dresden.description: Hochschule für Bildende Künste Dresden (HfBK Dresden) is one of Germany's oldest art academies, founded in 1764. It offers programs in fine arts with a strong emphasis on classical and contemporary artistic practices.

stadelschule-frankfurt.name: Städelschule Frankfurt
stadelschule-frankfurt.description: Städelschule Frankfurt is one of Germany's most prestigious art schools, founded in 1815. It offers a unique program combining fine arts with art theory and history.

khm-munchen.name: Kunsthochschule München
khm-munchen.description: Kunsthochschule München is a public art school in Munich, founded in 1946. It offers programs in fine arts and design with a focus on contemporary artistic practices.

application_route.notes: Bewerbung über das Online-Bewerbungsportal der AdBK München

fees.notes: Grundbeitrag für das Studentenwerk

technische-universitat-chemnitz.name: Technische Universität Chemnitz
technische-universitat-chemnitz.description: Chemnitz University of Technology (TU Chemnitz) is a public university in Chemnitz, Saxony. It appears here for its Human-Computer Interaction programs.

fees.appliesTo: students exceeding the Regelstudienzeit by more than 4 semesters (Langzeitstudiengebühr)
second-degree students whose total study duration exceeds the first degree's Regelstudienzeit by 6 semesters (Zweitstudiengebühr)
Fernstudium students of Bachelor Management and Bachelor Public Sector Management under the study regulations effective from WiSe 2026/27

kunsthochschule-berlin-weissensee.name: Kunsthochschule Berlin-Weißensee
kunsthochschule-berlin-weissensee.description: Weißensee Kunsthochschule Berlin trains artists and designers across several disciplines. It was founded in 1946 in Berlin-Weißensee; a distinctive feature is the foundation course in art and design that every student takes first.

hmt-leipzig.name: Hochschule für Musik und Theater Leipzig
hmt-leipzig.description: The University of Music and Theatre "Felix Mendelssohn Bartholdy" Leipzig (HMT) is a public school and Germany's oldest music conservatory, founded by Felix Mendelssohn Bartholdy in 1843. It is also home to the Church Music Institute founded in 1919 and, since merging with the city's theatre academy, trains actors as well as musicians.

hmtm-hannover.name: Hochschule für Musik, Theater und Medien Hannover
hmtm-hannover.description: The Hannover University of Music, Drama and Media (HMTMH) is an artistic and academic university with doctoral rights. Students in some 33 programs train as musicians, actors, music teachers, and music and media scholars.

hochschule-fur-evangelische-kirchenmusik.name: Hochschule für evangelische Kirchenmusik der Evangelisch-Lutherischen Kirche in Bayern
hochschule-fur-evangelische-kirchenmusik.description: The University of Protestant Church Music of the Evangelical Lutheran Church in Bavaria is a state-recognised church university in Bayreuth. Its programs centre on church music, organ, choral and instrumental conducting, and instrumental and vocal teaching.

hochschule-fur-musik-berlin.name: Hochschule für Musik Hanns Eisler Berlin
hochschule-fur-musik-berlin.description: The Hanns Eisler School of Music Berlin (HfM) is a public music university founded in 1950 and named after the composer Hanns Eisler. Since 1987 it has been based opposite the Konzerthaus on the Gendarmenmarkt, with the Neuer Marstall as a second site; it runs a symphony and a chamber orchestra, a choir and a wind ensemble.

fees.notes: No tuition fees charged for any student regardless of nationality.

hochschule-fur-schauspielkunst-berlin.name: Hochschule für Schauspielkunst Ernst Busch
hochschule-fur-schauspielkunst-berlin.description: The Ernst Busch Academy of Dramatic Arts (HfS) took its current form in 1951 as Berlin's state drama school, growing out of the Deutsches Theater's acting school founded in 1905. It became a university in 1981 and moved into a new building in Berlin-Mitte in 2018; it teaches acting, directing, dramaturgy, puppetry and choreography.

hochschule-fur-musik-detmold.name: Hochschule für Musik Detmold
hochschule-fur-musik-detmold.description: The Detmold University of Music was founded in 1946 as the Nordwestdeutsche Musikakademie and is housed in the Neues Palais in Detmold, North Rhine-Westphalia. Students and teachers give around 450 concerts a year, and its programs include a Tonmeister (sound engineering) degree.

hochschule-fur-kirchenmusik-dresden.name: Hochschule für Kirchenmusik der Evangelisch-Lutherischen Landeskirche Sachsens
hochschule-fur-kirchenmusik-dresden.description: The Dresden University of Church Music is a small, state-recognised institution of the Evangelical Lutheran Church of Saxony that trains church musicians.

fees.notes: 234,18 € Deutschland-Semesterticket inkl. MOBIbike + 55 € Verwaltungsgebühr

hochschule-fur-musik-dresden.name: Hochschule für Musik Carl Maria von Weber Dresden
hochschule-fur-musik-dresden.description: The Carl Maria von Weber University of Music Dresden is a public university-level music school. Founded as a private conservatory in 1856, it became a university after the Second World War; its programs run from classical performance and composition to jazz, rock and pop.

palucca-hochschule-fur-tanz.name: Palucca Hochschule für Tanz Dresden
palucca-hochschule-fur-tanz.description: The Palucca University of Dance Dresden is a public art university focused on dance, dance teaching and choreography. Admission depends on artistic and physical criteria rather than the Abitur, and it runs its own secondary school with intensive dance training.

fees.notes: Für jede Studienbewerbung wird eine Bewerbungsgebühr von 50,00 EUR erhoben.

robert-schumann-hochschule.name: Robert Schumann Hochschule Düsseldorf
robert-schumann-hochschule.description: The Robert Schumann Hochschule Düsseldorf (RSH) is a music university named after Robert Schumann. Its programs range from music and music education to "Musik und Medien" and "Ton und Bild", which combines a music degree with technical training at Hochschule Düsseldorf.

hochschule-fur-musik-und-darstellende-ku.name: Hochschule für Musik und Darstellende Kunst Frankfurt am Main
hochschule-fur-musik-und-darstellende-ku.description: The Frankfurt University of Music and Performing Arts (HfMDK) is Hesse's only public school for music, theatre and dance. It covers instrumental and vocal performance, music education, composition, conducting and church music as well as music theatre, acting and dance, and can award doctorates in musicology and music education.

fees.notes: For Wintersemester 2026/27
No tuition fees charged

hochschule-fur-musik-freiburg.name: Hochschule für Musik Freiburg im Breisgau
hochschule-fur-musik-freiburg.description: The Freiburg University of Music is a state school of Baden-Württemberg for artistic, teaching and research training in music, including church music, music education and teacher training.

fees.notes: Semesterbeitrag Studierende: 203,00 €
Studiengebühren für internationale Studierende: 1.500,00 €

evangelische-hochschule-fur-kirchenmusik.name: Evangelische Hochschule für Kirchenmusik
evangelische-hochschule-fur-kirchenmusik.description: The Protestant University of Church Music Halle was founded in 1926 in Aschersleben and moved to Halle in 1939; in the 1950s it was Germany's largest church music school. It became a university in 1993 and is now based in the Händelkarree next to the university's musicology institute.

hochschule-fur-kirchenmusik-heidelberg.name: Hochschule für Kirchenmusik der Evangelischen Landeskirche in Baden
hochschule-fur-kirchenmusik-heidelberg.description: The Heidelberg University of Church Music (HfK), run by the Protestant Church in Baden since 1931, focuses on church music, especially choral conducting and organ. It is one of six Protestant music universities in Germany and offers degrees up to the Konzertexamen.

application_route.notes: Application documents submitted by post or email to the secretariat

hochschule-fur-musik-karlsruhe.name: Hochschule für Musik Karlsruhe
hochschule-fur-musik-karlsruhe.description: The University of Music Karlsruhe is a Baden-Württemberg state school training musicians, composers, musicologists and music journalists, and offering music and computer technology.

fees.appliesTo: students of a second degree programme

hochschule-fur-musik-und-tanz-koln.name: Hochschule für Musik und Tanz Köln
hochschule-fur-musik-und-tanz-koln.description: The Cologne University of Music and Dance is one of Europe's largest music universities, located in Cologne's old town. Until 2009 it was called Hochschule für Musik Köln; its programs span orchestral instruments, voice, conducting, composition, church music, music education and dance.

fees.notes: Teilnahmeentgelt für das Auswahlverfahren
Wintersemester 2026/27
Wintersemester 2026/27
Wintersemester 2026/27

musikhochschule-lubeck.name: Musikhochschule Lübeck
musikhochschule-lubeck.description: The Lübeck Academy of Music (MHL) is the only music university in Schleswig-Holstein. It is housed in 22 listed historic townhouses that are part of the UNESCO World Heritage old town, and in the Holstentorhalle across the Trave.

fees.notes: Fee for participation in the aptitude test procedure.

hochschule-fur-musik-und-darstellende-ku.name: Staatliche Hochschule für Musik und Darstellende Kunst Mannheim
hochschule-fur-musik-und-darstellende-ku.description: The State University of Music and Performing Arts Mannheim offers classical music, jazz and popular music, teacher training, and dance and dance teaching.

application_route.notes: University study-place application is exclusively online.

fees.notes: Proof of administrative-charge payment by bank statement required.

hochschule-fur-musik-nurnberg.name: Hochschule für Musik Nürnberg
hochschule-fur-musik-nurnberg.description: The Nuremberg University of Music (formerly Hochschule für Musik Nürnberg-Augsburg) was formed in 1998 by merging the Meistersinger Conservatory in Nuremberg and the Leopold Mozart Conservatory in Augsburg. It offers artistic and artistic-teaching degrees, master classes and musicology.

hochschule-fur-katholische-kirchenmusik-.name: Hochschule für Katholische Kirchenmusik und Musikpädagogik
hochschule-fur-katholische-kirchenmusik-.description: The University of Catholic Church Music and Music Education Regensburg (HfKM) is a state-recognised church university. Besides church music it offers voice and instrumental teaching and choral conducting, and with the University of Regensburg a teacher-training route for music at Gymnasien.

application_route.notes: Direct postal application for entrance examination.

hochschule-fur-kirchenmusik-rottenburg.name: Hochschule für Kirchenmusik der Diözese Rottenburg-Stuttgart
hochschule-fur-kirchenmusik-rottenburg.description: The Catholic University of Church Music Rottenburg (officially Hochschule für Kirchenmusik der Diözese Rottenburg-Stuttgart) is a church-run art university in Rottenburg am Neckar. Its programs cover Catholic church music, organ, choral conducting, voice and Gregorian chant.

application_route.notes: Direct application to the university using official application forms

fees.notes: Studierendenwerk contribution 62.80€; Naldo ticket contribution is 0€ (covered by school)

hochschule-fur-musik-saar.name: Hochschule für Musik Saar
hochschule-fur-musik-saar.description: The Saar University of Music in Saarbrücken is the only university-level music school in the Saar-Lor-Lux region. Alongside performance and teaching profiles it offers conducting, church music, and cultural management.

hochschule-fur-musik-und-darstellende-ku.name: Staatliche Hochschule für Musik und Darstellende Kunst Stuttgart
hochschule-fur-musik-und-darstellende-ku.description: The State University of Music and Performing Arts Stuttgart (HMDK), founded in 1857, is one of Germany's oldest music universities and also a drama school. Its programs include music, opera, church music, teacher training, acting, puppetry and speech arts.

staatliche-hochschule-fur-musik-trossing.name: Staatliche Hochschule für Musik Trossingen
staatliche-hochschule-fur-musik-trossing.description: The Trossingen State University of Music is a state music university in Baden-Württemberg and part of the International Lake Constance University network. Besides music and rhythmics it offers music design and audio experience design.

fees.notes: für Studierende aus Ländern außerhalb der EU / des EWR
Anmeldegebühr für die Teilnahme am Zulassungsverfahren

hochschule-fur-kirchenmusik-tubingen.name: Hochschule für Kirchenmusik der Evangelischen Landeskirche in Württemberg
hochschule-fur-kirchenmusik-tubingen.description: The Protestant University of Church Music Tübingen is a state-recognised music university of the Protestant Church in Württemberg, training church musicians in classical and popular church music.

application_route.notes: Direct application sent to the Hochschule für Kirchenmusik Tübingen.

fees.notes: Semester contribution for Studierendenwerk Tübingen-Hohenheim effective Summer Semester 2025.

hochschule-fur-musik-weimar.name: Hochschule für Musik Franz Liszt Weimar
hochschule-fur-musik-weimar.description: The Franz Liszt University of Music Weimar is a music university with doctoral and habilitation rights in musicology. Its programs range from early music, jazz and composition to conducting, music theory, cultural management and teacher training.

application_route.notes: Die Bewerbungsunterlagen werden im Bewerbungsportal hochgeladen.

fees.notes: Der Semesterbeitrag für das Wintersemester 2026/2027 beträgt an der HfM Weimar insgesamt 341,30 Euro

fees.appliesTo: applicants for programs with aptitude test
fees.notes: Für Eignungsprüfungen wird eine Gebühr in Höhe von 50 Euro erhoben.

hochschule-fur-kirchenmusik-der-evangeli.name: Hochschule für Kirchenmusik der Evangelischen Kirche von Westfalen
hochschule-fur-kirchenmusik-der-evangeli.description: The University of Church Music of the Protestant Church of Westphalia in Witten is the only Protestant church music university in north-western Germany and the second largest of six in the country. It offers bachelor's and master's degrees in classical and popular (rock, pop, jazz, gospel) church music.

fees.notes: Application fee for participation in aptitude test

hochschule-fur-musik-wurzburg.name: Hochschule für Musik Würzburg
hochschule-fur-musik-wurzburg.description: The Würzburg University of Music is a state music university in Bavaria. It grew out of a Collegium musicum academicum founded in 1797, became a university in 1973 and today uses four buildings around the Residenz.

fees.notes: Keine Studiengebühren für reguläre Studierende.

filmakademie-baden-wurttemberg.name: Filmakademie Baden-Württemberg
filmakademie-baden-wurttemberg.description: Filmakademie Baden-Württemberg in Ludwigsburg is one of Europe's leading film schools. Around 500 students train in project-based Diplom programs covering directing, screenwriting, cinematography, production, animation, VFX and interactive media; its Animationsinstitut is internationally renowned (multiple Student Academy Awards). Studies start with a four-semester Grundstudium followed by a four-semester Projektstudium.

fees.appliesTo: Zweitstudium (applicants with a completed German first degree)

fachhochschule-dortmund.name: Fachhochschule Dortmund
fachhochschule-dortmund.description: Fachhochschule Dortmund (University of Applied Sciences and Arts) is a public university of applied sciences founded in 1971. Its design faculty offers project-based programs in film, sound, photography, visual communication, and object and spatial design; together with its consecutive film master it holds film school status in the international CILECT association.

fees.notes: Wintersemester 2026/27 semester contribution includes Deutschland-Semesterticket (226.80 €), AStA contribution (23.00 €), and Studierendenwerk contribution (97.00 €).

leuphana-universitat-luneburg.name: Leuphana Universität Lüneburg
leuphana-universitat-luneburg.description: Leuphana University of Lüneburg is a public university in Lower Saxony known for its humanities and social sciences profile and its college/graduate-school model. Its cultural studies faculty has a strong focus on media theory, digital cultures, and the arts.

bergische-universitat-wuppertal.name: Bergische Universität Wuppertal
bergische-universitat-wuppertal.description: The University of Wuppertal (Bergische Universität Wuppertal) is a public university in North Rhine-Westphalia with a strong design faculty and combined teacher-training programmes linking design disciplines with vocational education.

fachhochschule-munster.name: Fachhochschule Münster
fachhochschule-munster.description: FH Münster is one of Germany's largest universities of applied sciences. Its Münster School of Design (MSD) on the Leonardo-Campus offers design programmes including cooperative teacher-training tracks with the University of Münster.

goethe-universitat-frankfurt-am-main.name: Goethe-Universität Frankfurt am Main
goethe-universitat-frankfurt-am-main.description: Goethe University Frankfurt is one of Germany's largest public research universities. Its Institute for Theater, Film and Media Studies (TFM) is a long-established center for performance and media scholarship.

hochschule-offenburg.name: Hochschule Offenburg
hochschule-offenburg.description: Offenburg University of Applied Sciences is a public university of applied sciences in Baden-Württemberg known for its English-taught international graduate programmes in engineering and media.

carl-von-ossietzky-universitat-oldenburg.name: Carl von Ossietzky Universität Oldenburg
carl-von-ossietzky-universitat-oldenburg.description: The Carl von Ossietzky University of Oldenburg is a public university in Lower Saxony. Its Institute of Art and Visual Culture combines art history, visual culture studies, and artistic media practice, with strong teacher-training tracks.

universitat-bremen.name: Universität Bremen
universitat-bremen.description: The University of Bremen is a public research university and a center for media and communication research in northern Germany, home to the ZeMKI (Centre for Media, Communication and Information Research).

universitat-hamburg.name: Universität Hamburg
universitat-hamburg.description: The University of Hamburg is one of Germany's largest universities, with a broad humanities faculty offering interdisciplinary programmes alongside media and cultural studies.

europa-universitat-flensburg.name: Europa-Universität Flensburg
europa-universitat-flensburg.description: Europa-Universität Flensburg is a public university in Germany's far north with a European and intercultural profile, focusing on education, culture, language, and media studies.

heinrich-heine-universitat-dusseldorf.name: Heinrich-Heine-Universität Düsseldorf
heinrich-heine-universitat-dusseldorf.description: Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf is a public university whose art history department runs a well-known practice-oriented master in art mediation and cultural management, benefiting from Düsseldorf's dense museum and gallery landscape.

fees.notes: No tuition fees charged at Heinrich-Heine-Universität Düsseldorf.

deutsche-film-und-fernsehakademie-berlin.name: Deutsche Film- und Fernsehakademie Berlin (DFFB)
deutsche-film-und-fernsehakademie-berlin.description: Berlin’s film academy offers full-time study routes in directing, screenwriting, cinematography, producing, and editing & sound. Graduates receive an institutional DFFB diploma, not a state-recognised university Bachelor, Master or Diplom.

application_route.notes: Apply through DFFB’s specialisation-specific online process. For 2027/28, portal registration is mandatory by 24 November 2026 at 18:00; completed assignments must follow by 8 December 2026 at 18:00. No academic degree or related practical experience is required to apply.

fees.notes: Enrolment/re-registration and equipment insurance; current published amount, not tuition.

fees.appliesTo: DFFB students — amount and charge period need confirmation
fees.notes: The English admissions page quotes €226.80/semester for the first six academic years; the German FAQ quotes €208.80/semester for the first four. These official figures conflict. Confirm the applicable amount and charging period with DFFB; neither is treated as a verified universal fee here.

ifs-internationale-filmschule-koln.name: ifs Internationale Filmschule Köln
ifs-internationale-filmschule-koln.description: Cologne film school offering a Film B.A. with seven specialisation areas and four M.A. programmes. Degree students study in cooperation with TH Köln and enrol there. Tuition is programme-specific, with citizenship-dependent master’s fees. Its professional-training catalogue is separate from these degrees.

application_route.notes: Use each programme’s own application process. Film B.A., Serial Storytelling, Digital Narratives and Entertainment Producing publish ifs selection procedures. 3D Animation for Film & Games uses the Cologne Game Lab portal and additionally requires uni-assist validation for international applicants with non-German degrees. Degree students enrol at TH Köln; a direct submission is not a universal fee or credential-validation waiver.
